mandate.target: every stale/orphaned worktree that passes roomba.py's own checks (merged or provably abandoned, clean tree, not protected, past min-age, or a dead builder PID) is removed, with zero false-positive removals of in-flight work -- as a script, not a model pass
checklist: roomba.sh runs roomba.py dry-run, then --execute only when candidates exist
a candidate roomba.py could not decide is never listed, so it is never removed
crew-health ghosts are member_liveness_check.sh's job now (fleet-kit#512), from outside the container
mandate.escalation: a worktree or branch is ambiguous under the safety checks (age unknown, merge-base undeterminable because gh/network is unreachable) -- always KEEP, never guess toward removal. File a backlog item for a ghost that persists past N consecutive runs instead of alerting forever on the same one.
